description: Decorate dining tables, mantlepieces and windowsills with a selection of gorgeous candle holders, available as a single or triple, in two different designs - Festive Fir or Frost. Festive Fir is packed with rustic red and gold pinecones, stars, foliage and baubles. The frost collection features frosted cones, berries, bells, stars and foliage. Dried natural materials, plastic & glass tealight holders. Solo: H8 x diam. 15cm. Trio: H9 x W36 x D15cm. Tealights not included.
